name: Bored_2
short_caption: The robot lifts its right hand slightly, turns its head away, and stares off to the side, expressing boredom or indifference.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot slowly raises its right arm slightly forward with a loose hand shape. Simultaneously, it turns its head to the left, tilting it slightly upward as if looking away in disinterest. After holding this pose for a few seconds, it slowly lowers its right arm and returns its head to face forward, resuming the neutral rest posture.
